requirements: Repo chunking: function/block-aware + configurable chunk size (prefer 1-3KB logical chunks)
Embedding freshness: incremental embeddings on repo update; TTL policy configurable
Vector DB: must be able to run in-customer VPC or on-prem with AES-256 + KMS-managed keys
Latency: streaming completions target token latency <50ms within corporate LAN, POC target p95 <80ms
Throughput: support 150-300 concurrent IDE sessions during peak internal hours
Model pinning: ability to pin model version per-team and per-route, rollback to previous model instantly
Fallbacks/routing: route to smaller quantized models when capacity constrained; canary rollouts
Audit & retention: query-level audit logs, retention controls for embeddings and prompts (configurable 30/90/365 days)
use_case_summary: Primary: repository-aware IDE copilot for internal developer productivity (auto-complete, code search, function summarization). Secondary: batch codebase embedding snapshots for semantic search and cross-repo refactoring. High adoption hinge: low-latency streaming + confident, contextually accurate completions.
poc_scope: 1-week perf run: ingest 3-repo snapshot (monorepo + 2 services), run incremental embedding pipeline, validate vector DB in VPC, measure streaming token latency under 200 concurrent sessions, demo model pinning and rollback flow.
